comments.value: Upon further examination: This may be a spurious error on import; the packages were in fact installed.

details:
After creating a new project and importing the build 1184 beta SDK, I get console errors such as:

```
Assembly 'Assets/VRCSDK/Dependencies/Managed/Unity.Collections.dll' will not be loaded due to errors:
Unable to resolve reference 'Unity.Burst'. Is the assembly missing or incompatible with the current platform?
Reference validation can be disabled in the Plugin Inspector.
Unable to resolve reference 'Unity.Mathematics'. Is the assembly missing or incompatible with the current platform?
Reference validation can be disabled in the Plugin Inspector.
Assembly 'Assets/VRCSDK/Plugins/VRC.Dynamics.dll' will not be loaded due to errors:
Unable to resolve reference 'Unity.Burst'. Is the assembly missing or incompatible with the current platform?
Reference validation can be disabled in the Plugin Inspector.
Unable to resolve reference 'Unity.Mathematics'. Is the assembly missing or incompatible with the current platform?
Reference validation can be disabled in the Plugin Inspector.
```

It appears based on these errors that these dependencies are not automatically installed; however, in fact, they do appear to be installed. This is a bit confusing initially.
title: [1184] Spurious console errors claiming burst/mathematics aren't installed
